adversary_objection: The single allowed evidence (MISEV2023) is consensus guidance that prescribes principles for EV characterization and reporting but is not program-specific data. It therefore cannot by itself demonstrate that SGL-001 meets the CMC/analytics gating criteria required to advance into cross‑species PK/PD testing (i.e., it does not substitute for validated MCB/WCB records, orthogonal assay validation, GMP‑like batch records, stability‑indicating potency correlation, or formulation/device compatibility data).
next_action: Identify and cite supporting canonical evidence, or request evidence acquisition; withdraw unsupported conclusions and revisit this matter before proposing a state change.

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: Unsupported to advance. The supplied evidence (MISEV2023 consensus) establishes required principles (orthogonal characterization, controls, transparent reporting) but does not provide program-specific CMC deliverables (MCB/WCB, validated orthogonal assays, stability-indicating potency assays, GMP-like batch reproducibility). Therefore the program has not met the gating criteria needed to de-risk identity and potency claims before bridging studies.
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC/analytics artifacts are missing (see requested_evidence).
limitations: No program-specific MCB/WCB documentation, assay validation reports, batch manufacturing records, or stability/potency data were provided in the supplied evidence.
MISEV2023 is guidance (consensus) and not program data; it prescribes expectations but does not substitute for demonstrated, validated CMC outputs.
requested_evidence: MCB/WCB master records and characterization data
Orthogonal QC panel definition and validation reports for each assay (fit-for-purpose: LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy)
Stability-indicating potency assay development and correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint
Representative GMP-like batch manufacturing records (653 runs) with release data showing reproducible identity, purity, potency, and stability

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: Operational scale-up and lot-to-lot reproducibility are not demonstrated. The MISEV consensus highlights the need for defined production controls and reporting; no evidence was presented that source-cell banking, controlled scale-up processes, or reproducibility across manufacturing runs have been established.
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Missing manufacturing records and demonstration of reproducible scale-up.
limitations: MISEV provides expectations but does not include program manufacturing records.
No process maps, scale-up validation, in-process controls, or comparability protocols were supplied.
requested_evidence: Process description and scale-up plan with rationale for chosen unit operations
In-process control (IPC) criteria and data from scale-up runs
Comparability protocols and data between small-scale and GMP-like batches

reviewer_conclusions.conclusion: The single provided evidence source (MISEV2023) supports the general claims that orthogonal characterization and validated intact-EV assays are necessary, and that rodent-only biodistribution is insufficient without orthogonal analytics and bridging controls; however, it does not supply program-specific data to satisfy those requirements. Consequently, the hypothesis that a gating package is required before high-confidence cross-species testing is supported in principle but unproven for SGL-001 without additional data.
reviewer_conclusions.evidence_gap: Lack of program-specific orthogonal analytics, validated intact-EV assays, and bridging biodistribution controls.
limitations: Evidence is guidance/consensus text. There are no SGL-001-specific experimental or validation data in the supplied record to confirm compliance with MISEV recommendations.
Other cited experimental studies (rodent/large-animal biodistribution) are referenced in claims but their records were not provided in the allowed evidence set for this review.
requested_evidence: Validated intact-EV assay performance reports (specificity vs non-vesicular particles, LLOQ, precision)
Rodent intranasal biodistribution raw data with assay details and controls demonstrating signal attribution to intact EVs
Any existing non-rodent biodistribution data and methods used to detect intact EVs

selected_matter.question: What evidence-linked identity and potency framework is needed before comparing SGL-001 lots or formulations?
selected_matter.title: Potency and identity characterization
selected_matter.why_it_matters: Without reproducible identity and potency measures, observed biological differences may reflect uncontrolled product variability.

what_changed: The proposed state change was not sufficiently evidence-supported. No scientific, program, or decision state was changed.
why_selected: Selected quality_blocking matter with high advancement value. Deterministic ranking favors program-invalidating issues, then real-world stage blockers, product definition, deployment, quality, contradictions, experiment design, and refinement.
